nodes.name: Activity in the app
nodes.notes: The app calls this when FTG, a client's file or Team One did something someone should hear about (src/lib/activityEmail.ts). Open, like the upload emails: a client or Team One is only ever told how many of each, at an address this flow finds itself.

nodes.name: Find the client
nodes.notes: Clients who have signed in or been invited (database/activity_emails.sql). Anyone else is not emailed: the flow stops here.

nodes.name: Is it Team One's client?
nodes.notes: Only a client Team One has (database/activity_emails.sql). Any other: the flow stops here.

nodes.name: Find Team One
nodes.notes: Team One's logins that are switched on, not FTG's preview logins.
